Both sources agree: JARID2 canonical = 1246 aa (UniProt Q92833; Ensembl ENST00000341776), LRRC32 canonical = 662 aa (UniProt Q14392 sequence string; Ensembl ENST00000260061). Note the UniProt `length` field for Q14392 is corrupt (reports "3"), but the actual sequence is 662 residues and its mass (71,979 Da) is consistent with 662 aa.

Twice LRRC32 = 2 × 662 = 1324 aa > 1246 aa, so JARID2 is ~1.88× LRRC32 — not at least twice as long.
